title: Integral closure commutes with ind-etale base change
statement: Let $R,B,S$ be commutative rings equipped with ring maps $R\to B$ and $R\to S$. Assume $R\to S$ is ind-etale, meaning that $S$ is a filtered colimit of finitely presented etale $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Let $C\subseteq B$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Equip $S\otimes_R B$ with its tensor-product algebra structure, $(s\otimes b)(s^{\prime}\otimes b^{\prime})=ss^{\prime}\otimes bb^{\prime}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and let $C_S\subseteq S\otimes_R B$ be the integral closure of $S$ in this algebra. The canonical $S$-algebra map $S\otimes_R C\longrightarrow C_S$, $s\otimes c\longmapsto s\otimes c$, is an isomorphism. No injectivity, domain, Noetherian, finiteness, nonemptiness, or local-ring assumption on these rings is required.
